decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason: The redevelopment of the site for a revised layout to the petrol filling station and enlarged sales building are not considered to adversely affect the appearance of the adjacent Conservation Area. The additional retail floor retail floor area is negligible and will not have an adverse affect upon surrounding town centres. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing of Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Planning Policy Statement 6.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the sales building and disabled toilet shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description:
Redevelopment of existing petrol station for the erection of single storey sales building, a new forecourt, pump islands and pumps, tanks and canopy incorporating parking spaces. (00248/C/P15)

Installation of 2- internally illuminated wall mounted signs, 3- non-illuminated free standing service signs, 2D non-illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 2 - 3D internally illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 1- internally illuminated and 1 non-illuminated wall mounted COSTA signs, one internally illuminated double sided 1D sign, one internally illuminated and one non-illuminated double sided lollipop signs, one non-illuminated single sided free standing road poster sign, internally illuminated single sided wall mounted building sign and one internally and one non-illuminated single sided banner to petrol station.  (00248/C/AD15)
